name: spending
title: Spending
description: What was spent over a window (default: the last twelve months). view=summary: per period. categories: per period and category, with its share. transactions: the lines with merchant and category. fees: what each portfolio, or account outside one, paid in fees, net of refunds, beside its mean value, annualized fee rate and return; a trust's or a plan's fees count. spend and refunds are positive; net_spend = spend - refunds. Card payments, transfers and mortgage payments are never spending: they are in cashflow. Example: {view: "categories", from: "2025", to: "2025"}.

account.description: Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).

category.description: Keep categories whose label or id contains this (e.g. "groceries"); implies level=detailed.

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: Window start; snaps to the unit's start.

level.description: Category vocabulary of the categories view: primary (default, broad groups) or detailed.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

merchant.description: transactions only: keep only rows whose merchant contains this text.

period.description: Bucket size (default total: one row per category for the whole window).

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.

to.description: Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.
